name: mirage
text: You're right: if they're separate accounts, only the used ones should be below 500. Your screenshot shows every key down to 436-438 left, about 62-64 used each. usage.json also shows every key was called at different times, roughly 15 minutes apart, so the engine has been spreading calls across all 23 keys, not sticking to one. The code is supposed to stay on one key until it's spent, and I haven't found why it isn't. I've logged it as a task (OK1). In the meantime this wastes nothing yet: the keys still have about 87% of their credits each.
